messages:
Priya (SalesOps): Morning — quick async standup for the pipeline. TL;DR: Kestrel (Dedicated pilot) blocked on BYOK/HSM questions; NovoHealth needs SOC2 proof before next call; CR-1234 (KMS integration) needs eng review for keywrap edge-case. @Lee can you take a look? Also, flagging possible latency SLA ask on Kestrel (they care about p99 < 150ms).

Aisha (AE): Kestrel update — customer wants HSM-backed keys, legal on their side needs BYOK flow. Waiting on dev + security confirmation for attestation flow. On call today 3pm PT if that helps.

Carlos (SE): For BYOK we usually do keywrap + signed attestation from HSM vendor. Do we have an approved vendor list? Also wondering if Dedicated can plug into their HSM over an IPsec tunnel or we need on-prem adapter.

Lee (Eng): I can take CR-1234 today. ETA end of day for an initial pass. For latency: current Dedicated config uses batching that may raise p99 for short requests — I'll add a perf note.

Evan (Security): Re: HSM BYOK — we need HSM attestation report + key provenance docs. If they want HSM in their VPC, we need a network runbook and KMS integration checklist. I can share the checklist here: https://redwood-internal.example/controls/hsm-checklist

Priya (SalesOps): Thanks Evan. Can you drop the checklist snippet here or share a short runbook we can send to the customer before today's call?

Evan (Security): Pasting quick checklist snippet:
- vendor attestation (FIPS 140-2/3),
- key-wrapping algorithm compatibility (RSA-OAEP / AES-KW),
- attestation certificate chain,
- network access & firewall rules,
- key import flow and rotation policy.

Carlos (SE): +1 on RSA-OAEP. Also adding this command we used in the last BYOK integration:
```
aws kms import-key-material --encrypted-key-material fileb://wrapped-key.bin --key-id alias/redwood-customer
```
Might help their ops team.

Aisha (AE): NovoHealth: they asked for SOC2 Type II evidence. Is there a short pointer we can give? I don't want to send raw reports.

Evan (Security): We provide an executive summary + an auditor letter PDF for sales. Ping me and I'll attach the artifacts. I'll also include acceptable redaction guidance.

DeployBot: New ticket created: INTENG-1127 — 'Review CR-1234 KMS keywrap edge-cases' — https://tracker.redwood/INTENG-1127

Lee (Eng): Noted. I'll review CR and post comments on INTENG-1127. Ping me @lee if anyone needs immediate input.

Priya (SalesOps): Great. Action items: Lee reviews CR-1234 (ETA EOD); Evan provides sales-friendly SOC2 artifacts + HSM checklist (before 1pm PT); Carlos to draft BYOK runbook excerpt to send the customer; Aisha to prep 3pm PT call with Kestrel. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Aisha (AE): sgtm

Carlos (SE): will do.

Evan (Security): on it.
